CustomField.description: When the team owner receives the PMT notifications sent to the team owners (Custom Email Recipient of Type Apex Resolver, PMTTeamOwnerRecipients): a formula on ProjectProduct__c fields, evaluated by PMTCondition. Empty = always. E.g. ESG only for SFDR 6, 8 or 9 (US-20337).
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Salesforce formula returning true or false on the project, e.g. OR(ISPICKVAL(ProjectProduct__c.SFDRcategory__c, '6'), ISPICKVAL(ProjectProduct__c.SFDRcategory__c, '8')). The team owner receives the PMT team owners' emails and Teams messages only when it is true. Empty = always.
CustomField.label: Notification Condition
